name: APS Student Subscriber
summary: Discounted Student Subscriber grade of the Australian Psychological Society for students in accredited psychology programs.
key: The student membership fee is $80 for a full year, with all interest groups for $25.
who: Enrolled in an APAC-accredited psychology program, or a postgraduate research degree in psychology
catches: Student subscribers aren't eligible for the further fee discount other grades can apply for.

evidence.quote: unlimited access to all our interest groups for $25
You qualify for APS Student Subscriber grade if you are enrolled in an APAC-accredited psychology program
